lines.say: In 1919, molasses burst in Boston and killed twenty-one people.
Two million gallons, all at once. A wall of fucking syrup, down the street.
It knocked buildings off their foundations and pinned people in the sludge.
And here's the shit nobody tells you. That tank had been leaking for months.
The neighbors saw it. Kids were scooping molasses out of the cracks with cups.
So what did the company do? They painted the tank brown, so the leaks wouldn't show.
Paint. Instead of one damn inspection. Twenty-one dead.
Clients leak out the same way. Three weeks becomes nine, and you call it a slow month.
